author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). The canonical generic-HOF laundering route: an effectful function passed to list-map from a def declared pure. The application unify binds list-map's generic result variable to the argument's effectful type BEFORE the argument-boundary effect check compares them, so the check passes vacuously and the Console effect never surfaces in launder's signature. Declared-pure code performed I/O at runtime until effect rows stage 3b: list-map's row variable now carries the argument's Console effect into launder's ambient row, and the def boundary rejects it (CDX2031). This test is the enforcement's regression guard.
